# Remotion — Portable Fallback

Use when the project has or wants React-based video composition.

## Workflow

1. Inspect installed Remotion version/current docs.
2. Define composition size, FPS, duration and props.
3. Build reusable visual components and sequences.
4. Load assets deterministically.
5. Preview key frames/timings.
6. Render a representative/full output.
7. Inspect the artifact for timing, font, asset and performance problems.

Keep render inputs/versioned data reproducible.

Do not hard-code APIs from an older Remotion release.
